answer.answer: Yes. The updated Fern CI FAQ (fern-faq-new) now states that Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days, so the build-log retention period is now published. The earlier FAQ snapshot (fern-faq-old) recorded that the retention period was not specified; that statement remains valid only as a historical record of the prior FAQ state and has been superseded. Note that the published period is specific to build logs; the sources do not state retention terms for any other data, and no effective date for the update is given.
